Coerce a GPU table to a base data frame, tibble, list or matrix

Source: R/collect.R
tbl_gpu-coerce.Rd

These collect the table (running any pending lazy operations) and coerce the result as the corresponding method for a tibble does: groups are dropped (as for a grouped_df), and as.list() gives a plain named list of the columns, so lapply()/sapply() over a tbl_gpu iterate the columns.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tbl_gpu'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'tbl_gpu'
as_tibble(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'tbl_gpu'
as.list(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'tbl_gpu'
as.matrix(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A tbl_gpu object.

row.names, optional

Passed to base::as.data.frame().

...

Passed on to the tibble/data frame method.

Value

A data.frame, tibble, list or matrix.
